purpose: Teach: プロット/譜面/増刊/アセスメント/書き下ろし/個人向け/抵当/約定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新企画のプロットを至急まとめろ
lines.en: Get me a summary of the new campaign proposal. I need it immediately.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone. No filler. Each word lands with weight. Expectation of immediate compliance. Slight pause after the period — not a question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社歌の譜面を新調いたしました
lines.en: Understood. I've already had the company anthem music rewritten.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient delivery. Slight lift on 「understood」 to signal readiness. Professional, no embellishment. Matter-of-fact pace — just the facts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内報の増刊号を企画しろ
lines.en: I want a plan for an expanded in-house newsletter issue. Do it.
lines.style: Direct, clipped. No softening. Same commanding weight as the first line. Brief pause mid-phrase for emphasis. Orders, not requests.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新プロジェクトの環境アセスメントを進めています
lines.en: Understood. We're currently running the environmental impact assessment on the new project.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Measured delivery of progress. Slight emphasis on 「currently」 to show active work underway. Professional, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、来年の書き下ろし販促を計画しろ
lines.en: Plan out the exclusive promotional campaign for next year. Get it done.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding. Same executive weight as prior directives. Staccato on key words — 「plan」, 「exclusive」, 「next year」. Expectation of execution without question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。個人向け新サービスを開発中です
lines.en: Understood. We're developing a new service aimed at individual customers.
lines.style: Clear, businesslike update. Confident pacing. Slight warmth on 「developing」 — showing progress without overstatement. Professional but not robotic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不動産の抵当案件を確認しろ
lines.en: Review the mortgage documentation on that real estate transaction. Now.
lines.style: Clipped, final. Sharp attack on 「review」. Shorter breath between clauses. The 「now」 falls without plea — pure authority. Minimal inflection.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先との約定書を準備しました
lines.en: Understood. I've prepared all the contract agreements with our partner companies.
lines.style: Conclusive, assured delivery. Slight nod of finality on 「prepared」. Professional satisfaction — task completed. Steady pace, no trailing.
